comments.t: I have not had the growth that you have had with Careprost, lol I have not had to trim them. However I am still very happy with the lash growth I have had. At 62 it is so nice to have lashes that can be seen. Blessings to you from Texas.

I had used revitalash for several months, and had really great results. Then I started using the careprost and I really love it. I too have had to trim a lash here and there. I had used castor oil on my brows and didn't get any results in growth, but I do think it conditions the hair. Nathalie the beauty diva was on one I watched, I think a long time ago talking about this product, but I had just invested in the revitalash. I would tell people to use this over the revitalash for sure. I have had no side effects either. I on,y use it a couple nights a week to maintain what I have also...thanks so much for your follow up...xoxo

I hv never heard of this stuff but wow!! Your eyelashes look amazing! I hv only ever tried one eyelash growth serum & it did work but my eyelashes always itched. I need to check this stuff out. Oh I still wear black mascara!! Luv u ! 💗

Yay, for great eyelashes, Monika. It is fun to have long lashes in our 60's. I heard Marla mention that Black Castor Oil, but haven't tried it. You bat those lashes, my friend. Many blessings..MaryEllen

Oh wow! Your lashes are really long!  Now be careful about cutting your lashes as I did that once and I ended up cutting my eye lid!  I haven't done that again and don't need to trim my lashes but just be careful.  I'm really happy the product worked for you without any side effects  but like you mentioned it's not for everyone.  I really like that lip colour on you and you look so beautiful. How many times have I said you look like my sister?  Yes, I'm on it ... the picture is coming your way...  Hugs to you, Ana xo

Your lashes are fabulous! My lashes FINALLY grew back after chemo but they have remained very short. I have considered Latisse but I have very blue eyes and I am afraid of the possible side effect of changing pupil color even if only in a spot.
I do love your reviews for the reason that you measure and have a scientific approach. Most reviews are just : I like/love it".
Thanks for sharing.

Excellent results MaryEllen your lashes look great and so good to know it also works on the eyebrows.  My eyelashes at the moment have never been this long and putting mascara on them and seeing them just get longer is so awesome, thought I'd have to go and get those eyelash extensions but they are expensive and drop of when the eyelashes grow which is super quick.  Have a lovely day today :)♥

I have been using RapidLash since the early summer when Angie of HotandFlashy did a video on her experience with it. Even when I was young I don't think my eyelashes were ever this long. Now I alternate it with the Rimmel Lash Accelerator. I think the 'Accelerator' acts more as a conditioner (and helps keep the cost down), but whatever, my eyelashes look fab. I'm 77 and still flirting with those baby blues. Love your sense and your info, keep it up!

Good morning, MaryEllen! I was very interested in what you had to say about this subject, as I've been dealing with sparse-to-no lashes and sparse brows for probably 2 decades. I was so scared off by the early ads for Latisse in regard to permanent changes in eye color and discoloration of the eyelid so I never tried it.

I just turned 63 recently and I COMPLETELY agree with what you said...whatever I like and makes me feel good goes! I wear a bold eye AND a bold lip much of the time and don't care what people say! :)

Good morning, MaryEllen! I still have Latisse in my medicine cabinet from when I had my eye surgery, and it really does work. It works like magic, but then I stopped, and my eyelashes stayed the same length. I can't remember the price I paid, and I bought several containers.  It did make my eyelids browner which looked like taupe eye shadow.  My eye doctor told me not to use an eyelash curler, so I don't anymore.  Thank you for the info on this generic brand...love you my beautiful friend! Jeanie....xxoo

I've used it before and still do from time to time. I put my drop in the divot on the top of the cap and it really does go a long way!  I use it on my eyebrows when they get sparse too. Great review!  ~Mary
Never tried anything to enhance my eyelashes.  Maybe it's time!
